name: New Worktree Form
description: Asks for a new Git Worktree's Branch and Base with the TUI form's fields, defaults, validation and words, and creates nothing until it is submitted.

states: Inspect Branch, blank with help that a blank branch gets a generated name, and Base, blank with HEAD as its placeholder; Branch takes the keyboard.
Type a Branch starting with a dash, leave the field, and see the localized reason; submit and see Create refuse with the first refused field focused.
See the form Start Agent opens for its New Worktree… place, with the editable branch it proposes for the Agent.
Inspect the same fields, help, reasons and footer in Simplified Chinese.

useWhen: A person creates a Git Worktree from a Workspace menu, a Project's New Workspace submenu, or Search.
A person starts an Agent in a new Worktree from Start Agent.
avoidWhen: The person opens an existing checkout; use Open Worktree.
The person creates a Workspace in an existing directory; use the one-click New Workspace action.
invariants: The fields are the TUI form's: Branch, blank by default or prefilled with the branch Start Agent proposes, and Base, blank for HEAD. No other option is offered.
Text is sent exactly as typed. A non-blank field that starts with a dash or holds a control character is refused, and one longer than 1024 UTF-8 bytes is refused as too long.
A refused field shows its localized reason on blur or submit, the reason then follows the field until it is fixed, and a refused submit focuses the first refused field.
A blank Branch creates a generated branch and names the Workspace with the first unused default Worktree name; a typed Branch lets the Server name the Workspace.
Create closes the form and starts the creation, whose progress and outcome the authority's notices report. Cancel, Escape, the close button and backdrop dismissal create and start nothing.
Closing returns focus to where it was when the form opened, or to the active terminal when that place has gone.
